solution.content:
1. timezone field is missing from the request body
   - Cause: The JSON body of the POST request completely lacks the timezone field
   - Fix: Add the "timezone" field to the request body using one of the allowed timezone values: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3", for example {"start_date": "2024-01-15", "end_date": "2024-01-31", "timezone": "GMT+8",
 ...}
 2. timezone value is empty or blank
   - Cause: The timezone field value is an empty string "" or contains only whitespace "   ", the @NotBlank validation detects this
   - Fix: Provide a valid timezone value, must be selected from the allowed list: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3", cannot be empty
 3. timezone value is null
   - Cause: timezone is explicitly set to null
   - Fix: Provide a valid timezone value selected from the allowed list: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3"
 4. timezone key name is misspelled
   - Cause: Using a different key name, such as "timeZone" (camelCase) or "time_zone", etc.
   - Fix: Use the correct key name "timezone" (all lowercase, no underscores)

   - Cause: The JSON body of the POST request completely lacks the granularity field
   - Fix: Add the "granularity" field to the request body using one of the allowed granularity values: "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year", "customize", for example {"start_date": "2024-01-15", "end_date":
 "2024-01-31", "granularity": "day", ...}
 2. granularity value is empty or blank
   - Cause: The granularity field value is an empty string "" or contains only whitespace "   ", the @NotBlank validation detects this
   - Fix: Provide a valid granularity value, must be selected from the allowed list: "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year", "customize", cannot be empty
 3. granularity value is null
   - Cause: granularity is explicitly set to null
   - Fix: Provide a valid granularity value selected from the allowed list: "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year", "customize"

   - Cause: Using a different key name, such as "Granularity" or "grain_ularity" or "time_granularity", etc.
   - Fix: Use the correct key name "granularity" (all lowercase, no underscores)

   - Cause: The provided granularity value is not in the allowed granularity list (such as "DAILY", "Daily", "hours", etc.)
   - Fix: Only the following allowed granularity values are supported (case-insensitive, but lowercase is recommended):
       - "day" - daily aggregation
     - "week" - weekly aggregation (starting on Sunday)
     - "month" - monthly aggregation
     - "quarter" - quarterly aggregation
     - "year" - yearly aggregation
     - "customize" - custom date range

solution.content:
1. start_date and end_date are not the same when using day granularity
   - Cause: When granularity is "day", the system requires querying data for a single date, therefore start_date and end_date must be the same
   - Fix: Set start_date and end_date to the same date. For example, if you want to query daily data for 2024-01-15, set "start_date": "2024-01-15" and "end_date": "2024-01-15"

request_params.description:
Start date of the requested period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Limitations:

- Must use the YYYY-MM-DD format.

- Must be a valid calendar date.

- Must not be later than end_date.

- Validation is based on the requested timezone.

- The earliest selectable date is calculated as: current day in timezone - 1 day - 2 years.

- The exact boundary rules depend on granularity:

-- For customize, start_date must not be earlier than the earliest selectable date.

-- For day, start_date must equal end_date.

-- For week, start_date must be a Sunday.

-- For month, start_date must be the first day of the month.

-- For quarter, start_date must be the first day of the quarter.

-- For year, start_date must be the first day of the year.
request_params.name: start_date

request_params.description:
End date of the requested period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Limitations:

- Must use the YYYY-MM-DD format.

- Must be a valid calendar date.

- Must not be earlier than start_date.

- Validation is based on the requested timezone.

- For customize, end_date must not be later than the day before the current day in the requested timezone. The inclusive date range from start_date to end_date must not exceed 366 days.

- For day, end_date must equal start_date.

- For week, end_date must be within the selected week range: from start_date (Sunday) to the end of that Sunday-to-Saturday week, or to the latest selectable day if the week extends beyond today. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(startDate + 6 days, today - 1 day).

- For month, end_date must be within the selected month: from the 1st day of the month to the last calendar day of that month, or to the latest selectable day for the current month. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(month end, today - 1 day).

- For quarter, end_date must be within the selected quarter: from the 1st day of the quarter to the last calendar day of that quarter, or to the latest selectable day for the current quarter. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(quarter end, today - 1 day).

- For year, end_date must be within the selected year: from January 1st to December 31st of that year, or to the latest selectable day for the current year. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(Dec 31, today - 1 day).
request_params.name: end_date

request_params.description:
Timezone used for date boundary calculation, selectable date validation, and timestamp conversion.

Limitations:

- Enum values: [\"GMT+7\", \"GMT+8\", \"GMT-3\"]

- All date validation rules are evaluated in the requested timezone.
request_params.name: timezone

request_params.description:
Aggregation granularity that determines the validation rules for the requested date range and the reporting period.


Limitations:

- Supported values are customize, day, week, month, quarter, and year.

- customize is validated as a free date range and is internally queried as daily data.

- day represents a single calendar day.

- week requires a Sunday-based calendar week.

- month requires a calendar month range.

- quarter requires a calendar quarter range.

- year requires a calendar year range.

- Any other value is rejected as invalid_parameter.
request_params.name: granularity

request_params.description:
List of principal regions to be queried.


Limitations:

- Optional. If omitted or empty, the API queries all regions that belong to the specified principal.

- Duplicate region entries are deduplicated internally.

- The same region must not appear multiple times with different currency values.
request_params.name: region_list

children.description:
Target region code of the principal to be queried.

Limitations:

- Required for every region object in region_list.

- Must be a valid region code or region name recognized by the API, such as SG or ID.
children.name: region

children.description:
Currency used for amount-based metrics for the region.

Limitations:

- Optional for every region object in region_list.

- Supported values are LOCAL and USD.

- Invalid currency values are rejected as invalid_parameter.

- Defaults to USD when omitted.
children.name: currency
